name: product_mount
title: Under desk mount for a product
summary: Mount that hangs a real product from the catalog (a mini computer, a streaming box, a hub) under a desk or shelf, built from the maker's published sizes: screws up into the desk through its roof, wraps the sides, carries the product on two rails, front and back open for ports, with snap tabs so it cannot slide out; sized for the load.

params.name: product
params.help: the exact product, from the catalog (stone show reads it from the request)

params.name: material
params.help: PETG creeps less under a hanging load in a warm room than PLA

params.name: clearance
params.help: room per side between the product and the mount

params.name: load
params.help: the force the mount is designed to carry, in newtons

params.name: screw
params.help: desk screw size, M (4 = M4), pan head

params.name: tabs
params.help: snap tabs at the front so the product cannot slide out
